name: ridgeback-guard
description: One multi-task LoRA adapter over all five Ridgeback guard sets (question ids are unique, so one adapter serves every stage). Train with finetune.train; evaluate with finetune.eval_ridgeback (the pipeline's per-pack evaluate assumes one question set).
note: Not for `python -m finetune.pipeline` (its evaluate is per-pack). See finetune/README section 'Ridgeback'.
